test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The project __fell besides due to lack__ of funding and support.
solution:
The correct answer is **'4'** i.e. **fell through due to lack**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] ** __Key Points__ **

 
• The phrase "fell through" is an idiomatic expression me
